description: Hand-authored appsec-review/codeql-graph-export/1 objects over source/main.go for the Go pack. They are a deliberately chosen subset of what the pack would export (for example the file source of os.Open and several taint pairs of serve are omitted), written to exercise the Go cases; they are not a CodeQL recording. bqrs_sha256 values are SHA-256 of the text 'hand-authored synthetic bqrs <query_id>'; the manifest pack hashes are SHA-256 placeholders, not the compiled pack.

cases.sql_cross_function_flow: path_flows: r.FormValue (line 47) reaches db.Exec argument 0 at line 42 through lookup and the quote helper
cases.two_sources_one_command: path_flows: os.Args and os.Getenv (line 69) both reach exec.Command argument 0 at line 69
cases.argv_and_environment_sources: source_sites: os.Args (sourceModel commandargs) and os.Getenv (sourceModel environment) at line 69
cases.sanitized_path: path_sanitizers: filepath.Clean lies on the flow to os.Open at line 50, which has dominating_sanitizer_count 1
cases.ssrf_sink: sink_sites: http.Get argument 0 at line 52, model Http::ClientRequest
cases.deserialization_sink: sink_sites: gob.NewDecoder argument 0 at line 53, catalog API match
cases.dominating_guard: guards: count < 100 (line 55) dominates strings.Repeat at line 56, true_branch
cases.non_dominating_guard: guards: count < 100 (line 55) does not control strings.Repeat at line 58, which also has a none row
cases.guard_bounded_range: ranges: strings.Repeat count at line 56 is integral with upper bound 99 from the dominating guard
cases.narrowing_conversion: range_conversions: int -> int32 narrowing (step 1) then int32 -> int promotion (step 2) at line 58
cases.flow_summary_helper: flow_summaries: quote passes parameter 0 to its return value
cases.interface_dispatch: call_sites: dispatch -> h.Handle(input), two virtual_resolved candidates, line 29
cases.function_value_resolved: call_sites: serve -> pick(name) resolved to quote by local flow, line 64
cases.reflective_call: call_sites: serve -> reflect.Value.Call, external_undefined in package reflect, line 65
cases.unclassified_sink: sink_sites: json.Unmarshal argument 0 at line 60, model UnmarshalingFunction, which catalog.json does not classify
